rule.name: SpringCacheWriteInTransaction
rule.message: Write the cache after the commit (in a TransactionSynchronization afterCommit callback, a @TransactionalEventListener, or the caller once the transactional call returns), or make the cache manager transaction-aware (TransactionAwareCacheManagerProxy, or transactionAware() on its builder). Written inside the transaction, the cache keeps a value that a rollback undoes, and an early evict lets a concurrent reader put the old value back.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $writing := function($annotations) { exists($annotations[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional')] [not(AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'readOnly']/BooleanLiteral[@True = true()])] [not(AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'propagation'][.//*[@Name = ('NOT_SUPPORTED', 'NEVER', 'SUPPORTS')]])] | $annotations[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.transaction.Transactional') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.transaction.Transactional')] [not(AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'value'][.//*[@Name = ('NOT_SUPPORTED', 'NEVER', 'SUPPORTS')]])]) }, $runsInTransaction := function($method) { $writing($method/ModifierList/Annotation) or ($method/@Visibility = 'public' and not($method/pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static') and not($method/ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.transaction.Transactional') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.transaction.Transactional')]) and $writing($method/parent::ClassBody/parent::ClassDeclaration/ModifierList/Annotation)) }, $inTransaction := function($node) { let $method := $node/ancestor::MethodDeclaration[1] return exists($node/ancestor::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('execute', 'executeWithoutResult')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionOperations') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.reactive.TransactionalOperator')]]) or (not($node/ancestor::LambdaExpression[ancestor::MethodDeclaration[1] is $method] [parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[matches(@MethodName, 'commit|completion', 'i')]]) and ($runsInTransaction($method) or ($method/@Visibility != 'public' and $method/parent::ClassBody/parent::ClassDeclaration and (let $name := $method/@Name, $arity := $method/@Arity return exists($method/parent::ClassBody/MethodDeclaration[$runsInTransaction(.)] //MethodCall[*[1][self::ArgumentList or self::ThisExpression[not(*)]]] [@MethodName = $name][count(ArgumentList/*) = $arity]))))) } return //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('put', 'putIfAbsent', 'evict', 'evictIfPresent', 'clear', 'invalidate')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.cache.Cache')]][$inTransaction(.)] | //MethodDeclaration[$runsInTransaction(.)]/ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.cache.annotation.CachePut') or (pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.cache.annotation.CacheEvict') and not(AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'beforeInvocation']/BooleanLiteral[@True = true()])) or (pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.cache.annotation.Caching') and AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = ('put', 'evict')])]
